def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def new_line(raw):
    return '\r\n' if raw.count(b'\r\n') > raw.count(b'\n') / 2 else '\n'

def replace_header(text, prefix, value):
    pattern = r'^' + re.escape(prefix) + r'[^\r\n]*'
    updated, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda match: prefix + value, text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('宏观导航标题不是唯一匹配：' + prefix)
    return updated

def insert_before(text, marker, value, newline):
    if text.count(marker) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('插入点不是唯一匹配：' + marker)
    return text.replace(marker, value.replace('\n', newline) + marker, 1)

def section(text, start_prefix, end_prefix=None):
    start_match = re.search(r'^' + re.escape(start_prefix) + r'[^\r\n]*', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if start_match is None:
        raise RuntimeError('保存区段不存在：' + start_prefix)
    start = start_match.start()
    if end_prefix is None:
        return text[start:]
    end_match = re.search(r'^' + re.escape(end_prefix) + r'[^\r\n]*', text[start_match.end():], flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if end_match is None:
        raise RuntimeError('保存区段结束不存在：' + end_prefix)
    end = start_match.end() + end_match.start()
    return text[start:end]
